entries.title: Multi-record paragraphs
entries.summary: Paste a whole day of records in one message and Saka replies with a numbered plan card - 1 Save all, 2 Edit one, 3 Cancel. Every row is written and audited separately; no invented dates.

entries.title: Corrections 2.0
entries.summary: Ledger edits are now delete & re-log: the original entry date is kept, the old row is removed with a full audit snapshot, and restore can never duplicate a corrected row.

entries.title: Your records answer back
entries.summary: "How much did I spend on fuel last week?" is answered instantly from your ledger - sums, counts and averages, zero guesswork.

entries.title: Draft cards
entries.summary: Narrative logs confirm through a clean card - Vehicle, Type, Amount, Volume, Fill, Odometer, When, Place - with 1 Save / 2 Change / 3 Cancel.

entries.title: One sentence is a whole record
entries.summary: "Spent 5500 on diesel yesterday at Shell, 40L at 50350 km, full tank" is parsed deterministically into a ready-to-save log.

entries.title: Editable ledger
entries.summary: my entries → edit 2 / delete 2 → before/after diff and a 30-minute restore. Locked fields (VIN, plate, date) can never be changed.
